investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo was detected on the domain vitali-pharmacy.it, shown on a page with a contact form. The site uses branding assets that align with the Vitalis logo; the domain age is 8 years and the hosting IP appears typical for legitimate sites. The combination of a long-standing domain and plausible branding suggests legitimate brand usage rather than active impersonation or credential harvesting, supporting a Low Priority classification.
